records.jp: こんなところで何をしているのよ？
records.en_original: What are you doing here?
records.en_auxiliary: What are you doing here?
records.en: What are you doing here?

records.jp: 麻央……
records.en_original: Mao...
records.en_auxiliary: Mao...
records.en: Mao...

records.jp: 何を悩む必要があるわけ？<CR>負けたら死ぬんだから、勝つしかないでしょう
records.en_original: Don't tell me you're splitting hairs over this. It's simple: we need to win, or else we're all going to die.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't tell me you're splitting hairs over this. It's simple: we need to win, or else we're all going to die.
records.en: Why are you agonizing over this?<CR>If you lose, we die, so you have no choice but to win.

records.jp: あなたが負けると、こっちまで死ぬことになるの<CR>わかってるわけ？
records.en_original: If you lose, they die too. You know that, right?
records.en_auxiliary: If you lose, they die too. You know that, right?
records.en: You understand that if you lose,<CR>the rest of us will die too, right?

records.jp: わかってるよ……
records.en_original: Yeah I know, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah I know, but...
records.en: I know...

records.jp: じゃあ、その力を私によこしなさい。<CR>そうしたら、私が代わりに戦ってあげる
records.en_original: Then why not just give me your magical power? If you can't do it, I'll fight for you.
records.en_auxiliary: Then why not just give me your magical power? If you can't do it, I'll fight for you.
records.en: Then give that power to me.<CR>I'll fight in your place.

records.jp: まあ、あの二人は消えちゃうだろうけど
records.en_original: Hmm... Though I suppose passing your power to me might make Yuzu and Lime disappear.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Though I suppose passing your power to me might make Yuzu and Lime disappear.
records.en: Though those two will disappear, of course.

records.jp: いえ、いっそ先にあの二人がいなくなっちゃったほうが、<CR>戦う覚悟が決まるかしら？
records.en_original: Actually, that might be for the best! You wouldn't have much trouble deciding if they were already gone, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Actually, that might be for the best! You wouldn't have much trouble deciding if they were already gone, right?
records.en: No, perhaps you'd be able to make up your mind to fight<CR>if those two disappeared first?

records.jp: 麻央……！　なんてこと言うの！？
records.en_original: What's wrong with you!?
records.en_auxiliary: What's wrong with you?!
records.en: Mao...! How can you say that!?

records.jp: 二人が、ユズとライムがどんな思いで！
records.en_original: How could you say that knowing how much they care about us!?
records.en_auxiliary: How could you say that?! Knowing what they must be feeling...
records.en: Do you have any idea what Yuzu and Lime are going through!?

records.jp: ……それを今のあなたが言うの？　原種と戦っても倒せない、<CR>仲間に勇気づけられても心を決められない
records.en_original: Oh, like you're more respectful of them? They told you to defeat the Sephira, and you won't listen to them!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, like you're more respectful of them? They told you to defeat the Sephira, and you won't listen to them!
records.en: ...And you're saying that now? You couldn't defeat the Sephira when you fought it,<CR>and even after your friends encouraged you, you still couldn't decide.

records.jp: そんなあなたが、あの二人の思いとやらを考えているって<CR>言えるのかしら？
records.en_original: And you think you have the right to judge what I say? Come on, do you really have their best interests at heart?
records.en_auxiliary: And you think you have the right to judge what I say? Come on, do you really have their best interests at heart?
records.en: Can someone like you really say<CR>you're thinking about how those two feel?

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well, I...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I...
records.en: Well, I...

records.jp: 仮に、このままずっとあの原種を倒さずにいたとしましょう
records.en_original: Let's say you never defeat the Sephira, just beat it back forever. What then?
records.en_auxiliary: Let's say you never defeat the Sephira, just beat it back forever. What then?
records.en: Let's suppose you go on without ever defeating that Sephira.

records.jp: そ、そうだよ！　そうすれば二人とも、ずっと一緒に
records.en_original: That's it! That way they don't have to...
records.en_auxiliary: That's it! That way they don't have to...
records.en: Th-That's right! Then both of them could stay with us forever—

records.jp: 幻の中で生きるの？　それが現実じゃないとわかっていながら
records.en_original: Are you delusional? That's hardly realistic.
records.en_auxiliary: Are you delusional? That's hardly realistic.
records.en: Live in an illusion? Even knowing it isn't reality?

records.jp: それに、そうこうしているうちに<CR>私たち以外の人間が滅ぼされたらどうするの？
records.en_original: What if your refusal to make a decision ends up getting your friends killed, one after another?
records.en_auxiliary: What if your refusal to make a decision ends up getting everyone else killed, one after another?
records.en: And what will you do if, while you stall,<CR>everyone else is wiped out?

records.jp: 全世界の人間が原種のせいでおかしくなったら？
records.en_original: What if the existence of the Sephira drives everyone in the world mad?
records.en_auxiliary: What if the existence of the Sephira drives everyone in the world mad?
records.en: What if the existence of the Sephira drives everyone in the world mad?

records.jp: そんな状態のまま、世界を維持できると思っているの？
records.en_original: Do you really think you could live on like that? That HUMANITY could live on like that!?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you really think you could live on like that? That humanity could live on like that?
records.en: Do you think the world could keep going in that state?

records.jp: や、やめて……！
records.en_original: Stop it!
records.en_auxiliary: Stop it!
records.en: Stop it!

records.jp: わかってる……そんなのは、わかってる……だけど……
records.en_original: I know! I know what you're saying, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I know! I know what you're saying, but...
records.en: I know! I know what you're saying, but...

records.jp: ――わかっているなら、ちゃんと前を向きなさい！
records.en_original: No more buts! You need to move forward!
records.en_auxiliary: No more buts! You need to move forward!
records.en: No more buts! You need to move forward!

records.jp: あなた、前に言ったわよね？<CR>みんなの想いを、信じてるって
records.en_original: Do you remember what you told me before? <CR>You said you had faith in everyone's wishes.
records.en_auxiliary: Do you remember what you told me before?<CR>You said you had faith in everyone's wishes.
records.en: You said it before, didn't you?<CR>That you believe in everyone's feelings.

records.jp: 今のあなたはどうなのかしらね？
records.en_original: Can you still say that?
records.en_auxiliary: Can you still say that?
records.en: Can you still say that?

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: いつまで甘ったれてる気！？
records.en_original: When are you going to grow up!?
records.en_auxiliary: When are you going to grow up?!
records.en: How long are you going to keep acting spoiled!?

records.jp: もう今残された選択肢は二つ
records.en_original: There's only two options left at this point.
records.en_auxiliary: There's only two options left at this point.
records.en: There are only two choices left now.

records.jp: あなたが原種を倒してあの二人の希望を叶えるか、<CR>原種に殺されて絶望の中で死ぬかのどっちかなのよ！
records.en_original: Either you defeat the Sephira and grant their wish, or the Sephira wins and we all die in despair!
records.en_auxiliary: Either you defeat the Sephira and grant their wish, or the Sephira wins and we all die in despair!
records.en: Either you defeat the Sephira and grant those two their wish,<CR>or the Sephira kills you and you die in despair!

records.jp: 選びなさい。<CR>それがあなたの、責任でしょう……！
records.en_original: Pick one. That's your responsibility.
records.en_auxiliary: Pick one. That's your responsibility.
records.en: Choose.<CR>That's your responsibility...!

records.jp: ユズ！　ライム！
records.en_original: Yuzu! Lime!
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu! Lime!
records.en: Yuzu! Lime!

records.jp: あら、二人だけで戦うつもりかしら？
records.en_original: Oh, are you going to let them fight alone?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, are you going to let them fight alone?
records.en: Oh, are you going to let them fight alone?

records.jp: そりゃそうよね。大切なあなたを守りたいんだから
records.en_original: You're important to them. They're want nothing more than to protect you.
records.en_auxiliary: You're important to them. They want nothing more than to protect you.
records.en: Of course. They want to protect someone precious to them—you.

records.jp: あなたはどうするの？
records.en_original: So what are you going to do?
records.en_auxiliary: So what are you going to do?
records.en: So what are you going to do?

records.jp: 私は……
……そんなの、決まってる
records.en_original: ...There's only one thing left to do.
records.en_auxiliary: ...There's only one thing left to do.
records.en: ...I know what I have to do.

records.jp: （二人はいつだって、私のために動いてた。そして今も、<CR>私を、みんなを、この世界を守るために戦おうとしてる）
records.en_original: (Every action they took, they did with me in mind. Even now, they're fighting to protect me and the entire world.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Every action they took, they did with me in mind. Even now, they're fighting to protect me and the entire world.)
records.en: (They always acted for my sake. And even now,<CR>they're trying to protect me, everyone, and this world.)

records.jp: （自分たちの、命をかけて）
records.en_original: (Putting their lives on the line.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Putting their lives on the line.)
records.en: (Putting their lives on the line.)

records.jp: （なら、私が二人のためにできることは……！）
records.en_original: (Then there's only one thing that I can do for them...!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Then there's only one thing that I can do for them...!)
records.en: (Then there's only one thing that I can do for them...!)

records.jp: まったく。世話の焼ける……
records.en_original: That girl's a real headache...
records.en_auxiliary: That girl's a real headache...
records.en: That girl's a real headache...

records.jp: 今回だけよ
records.en_original: But this is the end.
records.en_auxiliary: That's the one and only time I'm doing that.
records.en: Just this once.
